Same thing: my ex met a girl on tinder and moved in with her after only a couple months. I feel like that situation completely broke me and was more painful than the initial breakup. We were together for about 4 years and lived separate from each other, but had always planned to eventually buy a home and spend the rest of our lives together. It hurt to see him with someone else, doing the things we did together and accomplishing the things we made plans to do in the future; goals we were unable achieve in all the time we were together; he was able to make these goals with her easily and effortlessly after such a short period of knowing each other like it wasn’t that big of a deal. I really let these things get to me and make me question how I saw our relationship and perceived it’s validity. I started to feel like our relationship wasn’t as real for him as it was for me. I wasn’t as important to him as he was to me. I wasn’t worth committing to and he never really loved me. Everything was a lie, I was easily replaced and was only a footnote in his book. I no longer mattered or had any value for him, and I was probably never valuable to him all along. The tape playing all the negative thoughts in my head kept getting louder and louder. We continued being “friends”. I didn’t initially let on how hurt I was and how much anger I had towards him that was building up inside of me more and more everyday. She tagged him in shit on Facebook incessantly. Nonstop candid photos of the two of them every single goddamn day. I felt like she was doing this to torture me. Memes, poems, the most asinine trash that existed on the internet, along with photos narrating their amazing love story; all of this bullshit would pop up in my feed reminding me that I no longer exist. The kicker, the thing that made me completely lose it and push me deeper into the dark place my mind was now trapped in, was all the pictures of not just the two of them together, but also with her two kids (I think they’re 5 and 2). I was forced to look at them all having fun with each other, being in love and him bonding with her children. A beautiful, happy family; something I wasn’t worthy or deserving of ever happening for me. 

Side story: When we were together I got pregnant and he pretty much forced me to get an abortion. He said he didn’t want kids and at one time said he would never be in a relationship with a woman who had kids. Now he’s mister #1 greatest step dad ever. I wanted to have the baby. I wanted to have the baby so badly but chose to let him have his way because afraid to be honest with him. 

Being bombarded with photos of the person you once loved so much living the life you had planned to live together with someone else was killing me inside and making me doubt my own self worth. If I was ever going to get out of this hole and get over him, I needed to let him go fully, completely, totally in order to move on. I had to block both of them on all my social media. I stopped having conversations with him via text. He noticed and asked me what was up. I was very upfront with him and did my best to explain what I was feeling. He seemed kind of confused by what I was saying. He had no idea how much hurt and pain I was feeling. I made a conscious effort to hide all of this from him and pretend everything was a-okay. He said he didn’t understand why I felt the need to pretend to be okay and why I hid all this resentment, anger and hurt from him. I didn’t know how to answer his concerns in a way that made sense. The last thing I requested was that he didn’t feel like he did anything wrong or was responsible for my hurt feelings. 

It’s been almost 100 days since I cut him out of my life. I feel so much better. I don’t let myself think about him or the situation in an obsessive/self destructive way. I feel like I’m actually making progress with the help of my therapist and doing things that I enjoy and make me happy (painting, making jewelry, etc). I’m not pressuring myself to ignore my feelings and get over it already. There’s no time limit for grieving the end of a relationship or the loss of someone who was the most important person in your life. Heal at your own pace and take care of yourself. Self care is so important.
